reports.title: The Sherwin-Williams Company Reports 2026 Third Quarter Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 GUIDANCE
section:
Fourth Quarter | Full Year
2026 | 2026
Net sales | Up mid-single digit % | Up mid to high-single digit %
Effective tax rate | Low twenty percent
Diluted net income per share | $10.92 | - | $11.22
Adjusted diluted net income per share (1) | $11.85 | - | $12.15
(1) Excludes $0.82 per share of Valspar acquisition-related amortization expense and $0.11 per share of severance and other restructuring expenses incurred through September 30, 2026.

“Customer sentiment and the leading indicators we track point to muted demand over the remainder of the year and into 2027. As we navigate this environment, our focus remains clear: win in the marketplace, serve our customers, offset inflation, reduce costs and continue to deliver profitable growth and shareholder value,” said Ms. Petz.

“Against this backdrop, we expect fourth quarter 2026 consolidated Net sales to increase by a mid-single digit percentage compared to the fourth quarter of 2025, resulting in us maintaining our full year 2026 sales guidance where consolidated Net sales are expected to be up a mid to high-single digit percentage compared to full year 2025. Diluted net income per share is expected to be in the range of $10.92 to $11.22 per share, including acquisition-related amortization expense of $0.82 per share and severance and other restructuring expenses of $0.11 per share, compared to $10.26 per share in 2025. Full year 2026 adjusted diluted net income per share is expected to be in the range of $11.85 to $12.15 per share compared to $11.43 per share in 2025. We remain highly confident in our ability to deliver through current conditions while building an even stronger Sherwin-Williams for the future.”
